newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Kabila appoints more ministers to new Congo govt.
newsitem.headline: Kabila appoints more ministers to new Congo govt.

text.p: President Laurent Kabila has appointed an economy minister and nine other ministers and deputy ministers to the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, state television reported on Thursday.
Pierre Victor Mpoyo becomes minister for the economy, industry and trade, while Thomas Kanza becomes minister for international cooperation.
The government of the former Zaire now comprises 17 ministers and two deputy ministers, most of whom are unknown to the general public.
Kabila seized power from former president Mobutu Sese Seko in May after a seven-month rebellion.
